Hi Samantha — Marissa here from Redwood Security & Compliance. Thanks for the call and context. Quick technical notes for the CAIQ and SOC 2 evidence pack:

- SOC 2 Type II: current report (covering our hosted inference service) is available via our secure compliance portal. I’ll provision a read-only access link for Acme and share it in a secure message to your security mailbox by EOD Thursday 4/22.
- KMS / Encryption at rest: we support both Redwood-managed KMS and customer-managed keys via our KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). For hosted customers who require it, we can configure a customer-managed key so that Acme controls rotation and access.
- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ is enforced for all API traffic; we can share cipher suite details in the CAIQ.
- Scope: confirming that the CAIQ responses will be scoped to our hosted inference API endpoints and the associated data processing flows. We will exclude internal analytics consoles and developer-only environments per your request.
- BAA: Redwood supports a standard BAA for HIPAA-covered workloads. Legal can execute a template BAA; I can pull together the BAA draft and share next steps.

I’ll attach a short evidence pack (network diagram + high-level key management notes) to the CAIQ XLSX we return. Camila — once we finalize the CAIQ I’ll also include links to internal procedures for incident response and data retention policies as needed.

Samantha — does Acme have a preferred secure transfer mechanism for the SOC report (e.g., secure portal access, ShareFile, or an SFTP)? I ask so I can provision the correct access.

Thanks — Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
